children: Royale Energy reported continued Permian Basin development with nine wells producing and a tenth being completed, showing strong initial well performance.
Ninth well began production May 2026; initial rate to royalty owners: 77 BOPD and 144 MCFD (company share from 1,031 BOPD and 1,915 MCFD).
All nine producing wells are performing at or above a three-mile lateral type curve of ~113 BOE/ft, ~80% oil.
Tenth well is being fracked and expected to begin flowback within ~30 days, adding to production base.
Estimates 30–39 additional Barnett drilling locations across ~12,940 gross undeveloped acres, depending on lateral length.
More than 40 potential undeveloped Woodford locations; plans to drill a horizontal Odom well in Jameson North Field in H1 2027 (100% WI in ~7,465 net acres).
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Royale Energy Reports Strong Permian Well Performance, 9 Producing Wells and 30–39 Barnett Locations
